title: AIxBio Defense Sandbox Act
last_action: Referred to the House Committee on Armed Services.
status: Referred to House Armed Services; expired at the end of the 118th Congress
summary: Would have directed the Department of Defense to plan a secure computing and data-storage sandbox for testing AI models trained on biological data and products generated by those models, including defense applications involving medical countermeasures and biological materials.
committee_dynamics: The measure combined secure AI-biotechnology testing with defense innovation. It is classified as adjacent because its primary mechanism was research infrastructure rather than a general safety obligation.
advance_rationale: The 118th Congress ended without enactment; the proposal would require reintroduction or inclusion in a later defense vehicle.
verification_level: Bill details and introduced text checked; end-of-Congress status applied.

claim_provenance.note: Inactive status reflects the end of the 118th Congress without enactment.
